name: m2-baseline
description: M2 baseline: each workload class on its own, in a fixed order, into one JSON. Test host only. Durations are the real ones; pass --duration/--warmup on the command line for a short smoke run.

steps.name: metadata
steps.note: Anonymous metadata reads (home, browse, series page, text search). No images, no writes.

steps.name: writes-sequential
steps.note: Established readers: page n+1 of the same chapter, then the next chapter.

steps.name: writes-random
steps.note: New or random positions: a random chapter at a random page every write.

steps.name: writes-hot20
steps.note: Write contention: every writer on the same 20 works.

steps.name: session
steps.note: Signed-in readers following the SESSION MODEL, spread over the whole pool. No images.

steps.name: session-hot20
steps.note: All readers on the same 20 works.

steps.name: images-warm
steps.note: Store covers, plus fixture page stand-ins when --fixture-images is given, after the warm pass. No real-source images.

steps.name: images-cold
steps.note: Unique fixture images, each fetched once, after the page stand-ins. Skipped (and listed in `omitted`) without --fixture-images.

steps.name: mixed
steps.note: Session plus the page images the reader loads while reading, as fixture stand-ins. Skipped without --fixture-images.

steps.name: release-burst
steps.note: Every user opens the newest chapter of 3 works at the same instant, then reads it (fixture page stand-ins). Skipped without --fixture-images.
